changeSet.comment: Dictionary entries for the accountant payment page and for shift scheduling; grants are assigned to positions afterwards.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO identity.permission (permission_code, scope, description) VALUES ('PAYROLL_PAY', 'BUSINESS', 'mark salary transfers as paid or failed, read full bank account numbers'), ('SHIFT_CONFIG_WRITE', 'BUSINESS', 'shift slots, staffing minimums and branch scheduling settings'), ('SHIFT_SCHEDULE_READ', 'BRANCH', 'view registrations, schedules and attendance of a branch'), ('SHIFT_SCHEDULE_EDIT', 'BRANCH', 'open registration, arrange and submit the schedule, create and mark attendance'), ('SHIFT_SCHEDULE_APPROVE', 'BRANCH', 'approve or return schedules, confirm or reopen attendance, edit a published schedule') ON CONFLICT (permission_code) DO NOTHING;
